Shiv, Dist. Barmer

. (Lodged In Sub Jail Balotra)
 ----Petitioner  Versus  State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp
----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Ramesh Siyag For Respondent(s) : Mr. SK Bhati, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MADAN GOPAL VYAS Order 21/04/2023
The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.19/2023 of Police Station - Pachpadra, District Barmer for the offences punishable under Sections 420 & 406/34 of IPC.

He has preferred this bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
2)
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner has falsely been implicated in this present case.
It is further submitted that the alleged offences are triable by First Class Magistrate and the co-accused Tirth Raj Singh has already been granted bail by learned Sessions Judge.
The accused- petitioner is in custody since long and the trial of the case will take long time.
Therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
3) Learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application and submitted that the petitioner is a habitual offender.

4) Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the [2023/RJJD/011520] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-4336/2023] case, this Court is of the opinion that the bail application filed by the petitioner deserves to be accepted.

5) Accordingly, the bail application filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is directed that petitioner - Onkar Singh S/o Tan Singh shall be released on bail in connection with FIR No.19/2023 Onkar Singh vs State Of Rajasthan (2023/Rjjd/011520) on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27360413/
